about: Published manuscript scans Milah can transcribe from, generated from the holding libraries' own records by src/build_scan_manifest.py in this repository. Do not edit by hand: regenerate it whenever src/scan_links.tsv changes. The images are linked, not copied — each scan stays on its library's server under the terms that library states, which are recorded with it.

scans.title: New Testament in Hebrew translation
scans.provenance: Folio [427]: Note in pencil: "NB The Book of the Acts of the Apostles Epistle to the Romans I. Epistle to the Corinthians II. Epistle to the Corinthians Epistle to the Galatians Epistle to the Ephesians Having been transcribed by some Indian Jew, of which the copy is in the Buchanan Collection marked Oo.I.16 is here omitted." Front paste-down : scribbles in Hebrew (and in Latin script?), some are legible: "ענין שרש התפילה", "ענין מצות ה...". Note in M. Gaster's handlist: "The New Test. translated into Hebrew found in Cochin. Rashi script. Copy made by Yates - beautiful handwriting - ... the statement that Acts of Apostles, Romans, Corinthians I&II, Galatians, Ephesians are missing. [Bought at Way Sale]. This volume containes exact transcripts of the four Gospels from the Hebrew copy of the New Test. brought from Black Jews of Travancore by Dr. Claudius Buchanan & deposited by him in the University Library Cambridge. Done from the original MS in the Jerusalem characters into the sacred or square characters by T.Y (Yates) 1810? Text has not undergone any correction. In it are to be found many examples of letters of the same origin and promiscuously. Some important misconstructions in the number & gender of nouns & persons of verbs. Some additions & omissions with several other inaccuracies whereof the transcriber thinks it necessary to forewarn the reader."
scans.attribution: Provided by The John Rylands Library
scans.licence: Images made available for download are licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported License (CC BY-NC 3.0)

Epistle to the Corinthians Epistle to the Galatians Epistle to the Ephesians Having been transcribed by some Indian Jew, of which the copy is in the Buchanan Collection marked Oo.I.16 is here omitted." Front paste-down : scribbles in Hebrew (and in Latin script?), some are legible: "ענין שרש התפילה", "ענין מצות ה...". Note in M. Gaster's handlist: "The New Test. translated into Hebrew found in Cochin. Rashi script. Copy made by Yates - beautiful handwriting - ... the statement that Acts of Apostles, Romans, Corinthians I&II, Galatians, Ephesians are missing. [Bought at Way Sale]. This volume containes exact transcripts of the four Gospels from the Hebrew copy of the New Test. brought from Black Jews of Travancore by Dr. Claudius Buchanan & deposited by him in the University Library Cambridge. Done from the original MS in the Jerusalem characters into the sacred or square characters by T.Y (Yates) 1810? Text has not undergone any correction. In it are to be found many examples of letters of the same origin and promiscuously. Some important misconstructions in the number & gender of nouns & persons of verbs. Some additions & omissions with several other inaccuracies whereof the transcriber thinks it necessary to forewarn the reader."
scans.attribution: Provided by The John Rylands Library
scans.licence: Images made available for download are licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported License (CC BY-NC 3.0)
